newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Normandy commercial EBIT down in qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Normandy commercial EBIT down in qtr.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said on Thursday its commercial minerals division recorded a 10 percent drop in earnings before interest and tax to A$5.5 million in the December quarter compared to the September quarter.
The result, with sales one per cent higher at A$48.7 million, generally reflected difficult trading conditions in the building sector, it said in its quarterly report.
Normandy said magnetite sales fell 10 percent after an exceptional previous quarter but remained above budget.
Industrial minerals sales rose 10 percent with strong domestic demand for talc, traded products and feldspar, it said.
Omya Southern calcium carbonate sales were flat with strong demand for agricultural products offset by low demand in the building products area, the company said.
Larvik pigment sales were down four percent due to marginally lower demand in Europe and Asia, it said.
The report did not provide sales or comparative figures.
